prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE standalone high-fidelity mobile app interface image, a tall portrait approximately 1024x2048, entire clean front-on screen filling the image, no phone hardware, no perspective, no promotional canvas, no website hero. Product is a Russian-language family medication organiser named «медика». It is a purely synthetic visual concept, never medical advice. Show an original, exceptionally designed real iPhone operating screen, with genuinely excellent typography, visual hierarchy, material and art direction. This replaces a rejected generic rounded-card-stack app. Main task region must dominate; no giant illustration, welcome greeting, date, Today label, calendar or charts. LIGHT THEME ONLY. Absolutely no blue or navy dominant palette and no black/dark theme.
SHARED EXACT CONTENT, same in all directions: small wordmark «медика» at top. Compact main heading «Приёмы». Family selection «Все», «Лена», «Миша», «Мама», «Папа», with «Все» selected. Open meal heading «Завтрак». Four medication rows, organised clearly for their respective people:
Лена, passive small status «Острая фаза».
1. «Спрей для носа» — «2 пшика» — «Ещё 5 дней». Three progress dots, first filled, two outlined. Separate generous round checked intake action.
2. «Капли» — «5 капель» — «Ещё 3 дня». Two outlined dots. Separate generous outlined intake action.
Миша, passive small status «Поддерживающая».
3. «Раствор» — «1 мл» — «Ещё 4 дня». Two dots, first filled. Separate checked intake action.
4. «Капсулы» — «1 капс.» — «Последний день». One outlined dot. Separate outlined intake action.
After these, start open heading «Обед» to establish a continuing scrollable schedule. A comfortable lower full-width voice event button «Событие голосом» with a restrained mic symbol, then three native-looking bottom destinations «Приёмы», «Лекарства», «История». Maintain proper safe areas and legible, realistic finger-sized targets. Russian copy accurately spelled. Dose, patient identity, remaining days and actionable take check are primary; no unnecessary text, no fraction like 1/3 or «1 из 3». No popup or toast. Keep all medication text comfortably readable, enough room for both patients and four medications in a believable normal first viewport; lower meal heading can be near the fold. Never copy another brand's interface.
DIRECTION VD3, «Доза и забота». A distinctive optimistic family utility with refined warm-coral art direction and asymmetric dose-led modules. Warm shell #FFF7F3, clean white utility surfaces, deep cacao #48352F text, coral #B85D48 action controls, restrained mauve #8A6C94 person accents. Modern rounded sans, names 22px, doses around32px, course17px, balanced so name and patient stay obvious. Compose a coherent grouped medication surface with beautifully proportioned left labels and separately staged right dosage/remaining-days zones, never a stack of identical rectangles. Quiet warm-coral family header bands or insets, small tasteful medicine-form miniatures or embossed silhouettes to make the real product objects identifiable, no giant images. Make it feel like an original polished consumer app rather than iOS Settings recoloured pink. The main content is still a dense useful family prescription workspace; generous intake touch actions, dot-only intake progress, all four remaining-course labels, compact voice event dock and actual bottom navigation.
Important: Materially different from the sculpted green ceramic organiser and from the flat green list. Use strong coral dose-led geometry and restrained warm-white depth, no green dominant areas and no embossed tray.
